title: Zephyr: /sensors/location GET
notes: Verified existing clean Zephyr /sensors/location GET implementation in coap_location.c against spec appendix-senml F.3 and current public-mode profile. Resource uses bounded 192-byte stack payload, SenML-CBOR Content-Format 112, EUI-64 base name, fix time, optional altitude/accuracy, and maps unavailable/stale coordinates to 4.04 and encoder failure to 5.00. Freshness/source selection is enforced by the HAL snapshot provider; privacy modes remain deliberately scoped to separate bead project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.10.5.4.4. Evidence 2026-08-27: C SenML host ctest 1/1 PASS (UBSan); Python location vector/resource pytest 46/46 PASS; Rust shared senml_location vector test 6/6 PASS byte-exact; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 HAL suite 27 PASS, 0 FAIL, 6 SKIP, including fresh/source precedence/stale suppression and fallback cases. No source edits; avoided actively owned CoAP wiring/SenML files.
